title: Machine Learning Data Practices through a Data Curation Lens: An Evaluation Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dataset documentation (using a developed data curation rubric) across 25 ML datasets to determine if creators reflect on the social, historical, and representational biases present in their data sources and sampling procedures.

Applying a data curation rubric to assess if dataset creators actively document and reflect on the biases introduced by their own subjective decisions and data science work-processes during problem formulation, data preparation, and annotation.
